Will (Japanese: イツキ Itsuki) is a and member of the Indigo Elite Four.

==In the core series games==
Will is the first member of the Indigo League Elite Four in the Generation II and Generation IV games, filling in the spot previously filled by Lorelei. He achieved his Elite Four position fairly recently as a result of around the with his Pokémon and he has a strong ambition to become the strongest trainer in the world.

===Appearance===
Will is a tall, slender man with straight, shoulder-length purple hair that curves inward at the ends, parted to the side and covering his right eye. He wears a black domino mask that conceals the area around his eyes. His visible eye is dark and narrow.

In Generation II, Will wears a formal, dark brown blazer with a subtle textured pattern and red cuffs, paired with a light blue collared shirt and a red tie. His trousers are magenta, slightly flared at the bottom, and he wears black shoes. His left hand is gloved in white, while his right hand remains uncovered.

In , Will's outfit becomes more elaborate. He wears a black patterned sleeveless tailcoat with gold trim and four large yellow buttons arranged in two rows. The coat is open at the front, revealing a purple undershirt and a wide yellow waistband. Underneath the tailcoat, he wears a white cravat. His magenta pants remain the same in color, and he wears black shoes. His hairstyle and mask remain consistent with his earlier appearance.

==In the side series games==
===Pokémon Stadium 2===
Will appears as a member of the Elite Four in Pokémon Stadium 2's Johto Gym Leader Castle. Due to the more competitive nature of the game, Will also uses several non-Psychic Pokémon in it, although most of them still know Psychic moves.

During the game's end credits, he is seen having a battle with Sabrina.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
 
====History====
=====Past=====
Will, along with Karen, , , Sham, and Carl, was one of the children raised by the Masked Man to be his servants. Unlike Silver and Green, Will was not kidnapped and went to the Masked Man willingly out of boredom.

===== =====
Will debuted with Karen at the Ilex Forest, where they have been tasked with guarding the area. When Green arrived to stop the Masked Man's plan to capture , she was attacked by Will and Karen. With the they borrowed from the Masked Man, Will and Karen exploited Green's fear of birds to torture her. When Green learned that Will and Karen also defeated and captured Silver, she overcame her fear of birds and sent out , , and to fight. Green and her allies, and , each used one of the legendary birds to battle Will and Karen. With the assistance of many Pokémon sent from all across Johto and Kanto, Lugia and Ho-Oh were freed from the Masked Man's control and flew away. Defeated, Will made his escape, only to be punished later by the Masked Man for doing so.

After the Masked Man's defeat, Will and Karen were approached by Bruno and Koga, who offered to form an alliance since all four of them were once members of various criminal organizations.

===== =====
It is revealed that Will, Karen, Bruno, and Koga were all made members of the Johto Elite Four by the Pokémon Association. The Johto Elite Four went to the Pokéathlon as an act of promotion for the Pokémon League. There, they met , whom they challenged to the Power Course. Although they easily defeated Gold in the first two events, Gold gained enough points in the third event to win overall.

===Pokémon Pocket Monsters===
 
Will appeared in A Challenge to the Elite Four. He, along with Bruno and Koga, fell from the Elite Four Tower, seemingly defeated by Karen. Red asked them what happened, but Koga asked him to ask Karen herself. It is later revealed that after being exhausted from training, Karen decided to tell them a joke, and they fell down the building after hearing her dumb joke.

==Trivia==
Will's Xatu both know Psychic below the natural learn level. This may be because Will resides in Kanto, where Mr. Psychic lives in Saffron City and gives out Psychic TMs.
Will's hair falls over the left side of his face, leading to his left eye being whited out in some depictions. This is rectified in , where his overworld sprite clearly shows two eyes, both obscured by white.
Will has several similarities with Lorelei: both of them are the first challenger of Kanto Elite Four; both of them have used and in their respective parties; they have similar hairstyles; and both of them have had their hair depicted as either purple or red.
There is data in for the gender of every Trainer class in the game, with the exception of Eusine. This is used to select which dialogue pool to sample from when randomly choosing the opponent's dialogue. Will is one of two male characters to be identified as female in this array, the other being Bugsy.
All of Will's Pokémon (excluding Jynx, which is a female-only species) changed from male in to female in HeartGold and SoulSilver.
Similarly to Saturn, Bugsy, and Janine, Will's Pokémon are the opposite gender despite them having a 50-50 gender ratio.
Will is the only member of the Indigo Plateau Elite Four (in Generation II and HeartGold and SoulSilver) that uses only Pokémon of the type that he specializes in the first match. All others have at least one Pokémon not of their specialty in their first match, and, with the exception of Lance, replace the Pokémon not of their specialty with Pokémon of their specialty in rematches.
He shares this trait with Lucian of the Sinnoh Elite Four in . Coincidentally, both use Psychic-type Pokémon.
Although Elite Four members usually aren't known to have titles or slogans like Gym Leaders do, a in Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket refers to Will as "The Man in the Mysterious Mask." This is consistent with how added themed collections about Whitney and Morty, named after their respective Gym Leader titles.
This would make Will one of the few Elite Four members in the series to have a title.
Some Elite Four members known to have used a slogan at some point are Koga and Larry.
